pattern.crimePattern: a retired government driver, driven by his son, strangles the old watchman who wrote down his car's number on the night Joseph Mwenda was killed
pattern.notes: Fictional watchman, driver, families, church and newspaper; Bahati is a setting only. The GK plate is fictional and abbreviated. Pius's last words in the room ("It's done. Tell her it's done.") become a t_kivuli spine fact for case 100; his full statement comes after the verdict.

ob.text: A grandson reports his grandfather, Mzee Elijah Ngeno (76), a retired night watchman and church usher, found dead in his house on the family farm at Bahati, Nakuru.

facts.text: Mzee Elijah Ngeno was found dead in his sitting room at Bahati on Tuesday morning.
Strangled with a sisal rope; the goat pen's tether is missing one length. His phone is in his pocket, unused.
KSh 4,000 in Elijah's Bible, untouched.
The hymnbook's inside front cover is torn out; a strip at the spine shows the pencilled end of a number: "…94".
Two cups of tea: Elijah's half drunk, the other full. A visitor he knew well enough to make tea for.
A car stopped at the lane end; one set of a man's smart leather soles from the car to the house and back.
Cecilia: Elijah had words with Mama Nyambura about the goats again; Amos wanted to sell an acre and Elijah said no.
Cecilia was at their daughter's in Molo from Saturday.
Joel: on Friday Elijah showed him a car number inside the hymnbook cover, GK and more. "I saw the car the night the surveyor died. I was too afraid. On Tuesday I'll go."
Joel was at the church youth vigil from 21:00 to midnight.
The bar owner: Amos drank there from 20:00 to 01:00.
Winnie's post, Monday 16:10: "An old man here remembers things." Forwarded at 17:30 into a Nakuru church elders' group that includes Pius Cheruiyot.
Newsroom log: Winnie was back in Nakuru by 18:30 and filing until 23:00.
The women's group: Nyambura was at an overnight prayer, 21:00 to 05:00.
Records ①: Pius's phone was off from 21:40 to 23:30 on Monday; it is never off on a Monday night, when his choir group messages.
Records ②: Ivan's car left Nakuru at 21:55, stood at Elijah's lane end 22:20–22:50, and was back at 23:15.
In Pius's jiko ash: half-burned hymnbook board, the pencil still legible: "GK A…094".
Pius's leather shoes have red Bahati murram in the welt.
Fingerprints taken from Pius in detention.
Post-mortem: strangled with a rough fibre rope; no head injury.
Post-mortem: death on Monday between 22:15 and 23:00.
Vehicle register, twelve years ago: GK A…094 was allocated to the Director of Land Adjudication; assigned driver, Pius Cheruiyot.
Comparison: the lane prints match Pius's shoes, sole and size.
Lab: Pius's prints on the full cup.
Lab: sisal fibres on Pius's shirt cuffs match the goat-pen rope.
Missing: the inside cover of his hymnbook, where he'd written the car's number, is torn out.
Missing: the visitor's tea is untouched.
Missing: his phone was never used to call for help.
Missing: a length of rope is gone from the goat pen.
Missing: Pius's phone was off for two hours.

Pius: "I went to pray with him. We knew each other from conventions. He made me tea. I asked to see his hymnbook. I tore out the cover and he tried to take it back."
Pius: "I never touched any rope."
Pius: "That night on the Bahati road, Mr. Oduya made a call from the back seat: 'It's done. Tell her it's done.' I have heard it every night for twelve years."
Ivan: "I didn't drive anywhere on Monday night."
Ivan: "Dad said he had to pray with an old friend in Bahati. I waited in the car half an hour. He came back without a word and was sick by the road."
Amos: "I was home all night."

interrogations.intro: Pius folds his hands on the table as if in church. "I was at home on Monday night. I hardly knew Elijah."
Ivan won't look at his father through the glass. "I didn't drive anywhere on Monday night."
Amos stands in his gumboots by the door. "I was home all night."
Mama Nyambura folds her arms. "His goats ate my maize for ten years. I was at prayers."
Winnie has been crying. "I only wrote 'an old man remembers things'."
Elder Joel sits in the vestry with his stick across his knees.
Mama Cecilia holds the hymnbook in her lap.

contradictions.reaction: "I was at the bar. I wanted to sell some land. Grandpa said no. I'd never touch him."
"Dad said he needed to pray with an old friend in Bahati, urgently. I waited in the car half an hour. He came back without a word and was sick by the road."
Pius looks at the scrap of board for a long time. "I went to pray with him," he says.
"That night on the Bahati road Mr. Oduya made a call from the back seat. He said: 'It's done. Tell her it's done.' I have heard those words every night for twelve years."

reconstruction.text: Twelve years ago, watching the dairy gate, Elijah sees a white government Land Cruiser stop behind a parked car on the Bahati road, a man get out of the back with a bar, and hears a cry. He writes the number inside his hymnbook and tells no one.

After case 94 the papers say the Mwenda file is open. On Friday Elijah shows Elder Joel the number. On Monday a reporter visits; her post, "an old man remembers things", reaches a Nakuru church elders' group at 17:30. Pius reads it. He drove that car.

At 21:40 Pius switches off his phone; at 21:55 Ivan drives him to Bahati. Elijah knows him from church conventions and makes tea. Pius asks to see the hymnbook "to pray with you", tears out the cover, and when Elijah reaches for it, strangles him with a length of the goat pen's rope.
He walks back down the lane to the car. Ivan drives him home. The cover goes into the jiko; one corner doesn't burn.

afterVerdict.beat: Pius asks for his pastor and for Amani. "Twelve years ago I drove Mr. Raphael Oduya in GK A…094. One night he said, 'Bahati, and don't ask.' We picked up a mechanic in Nakuru, a man from Kisumu, with a bag."

"The mechanic got out behind a parked car. I heard a man shout once. He came back with a wallet and a cloth-covered notebook. Mr. Oduya put the notebook in his briefcase. Then he made a call: 'It's done. Tell her it's done.'"

files.text: The killing reconstructed: Benedict Mbuvi killed Joseph Mwenda; Raphael Oduya was present and in command; Pius Cheruiyot drove GK A…094.
Quote pinned: "It's done. Tell her it's done." (Raphael Oduya, by phone, the night Joseph died.)

afterVerdict.beat: Amani's notebook lists three names. Only one is a woman. The game doesn't say what to conclude.
Mama Cecilia gives Amani the hymnbook: "He would want the surveyor's child to have it." It sits on the desk.

clockPlan.note: Three stamps (the maximum): records on Pius's line and Ivan's tracker, and a warrant on Pius's house. Detain Pius after the search; prints (6 h) and fibres (12 h) inside 24 h.
